snippet.description:
Store: https://saikeystudios.com/product/168130/tunnel-escape-fates-entwined/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=post
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4285110/Tunnel_Escape_Fates_Entwined/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=post

Fight through a zombie-ravaged city as Olivenia, a daring cop on an escort mission in this rogue-lite RPG/ADV. Use various weapons and upgrade your gear to survive brutal gunplay and deadly encounters where every choice counts. Fail, and very bad things might happen to her…
